name: gaming-news-bot
description: 🎮 Auto-publishes gaming news from Destructoid to Facebook & Instagram

scripts.test:caption: node -r dotenv/config -e "const {generateContent}=require('./src/ai');const a={title:'Elden Ring DLC Announced',summary:'FromSoftware reveals massive expansion with new bosses, areas, and lore.',link:'https://example.com'};(async()=>{const fb=await generateContent(a,{platform:'facebook'});const ig=await generateContent(a,{platform:'instagram'});console.log(JSON.stringify({facebook:fb,instagram:ig},null,2));})()"
